Without running code, trace this Python program and return exactly the three printed integers separated by single spaces, with no explanation:

x = 3
y = 5
arr = [2, 9, 7, 1]
for i in range(8):
    j = i % len(arr)
    if (x + arr[j] + i) % 2 == 0:
        y += arr[j] - i
        x += 1
    else:
        x += (y % 5) - 1
        arr[j] = arr[j] + x - i
print(x, y, sum(arr))
